inference: Session-level log-ratio t intervals use only two independently launched sessions (df=1), conditional on independence and approximate normality. A single host in fixed sequential order does not establish those assumptions. Quartets remain nested in shared browsers/pages; pooled quartet/frame distributions are descriptive, not independent replications. Page order and quartet start reverse together, confounded with session/time.
priorEvidence: No cf0 900-frame or 30-frame smoke timings are pooled into full 300-frame timing. Smoke is admission only.
limits: Software GPU paint workload with scene submissions disabled; no device/presented FPS claim.
Exact recorded state/score endpoint/paint/BVH parity is not all pixels, audio, intermediate HUD frames, winner/judge/finish, or external-device behavior.
Per-frame wall excludes observers; renderer ThreadTime includes digest/counter/CDP observer work.
A/A timing-noise assessment is separate from state parity. No numerical noise acceptance threshold was predeclared.
Conditional quartet log-ratio t intervals assume approximate normality/independence; persistent page effects, drift, host interference, and shared-browser dependence can invalidate coverage.
Heap snapshots do not identify individual GC events, allocation causality, or leak absence.
